Leyland Trade Contract is a brilliant white, high-opacity silk emulsion paint designed for interior walls and ceilings. This water-based paint is ideal for trade professionals and DIYers working on large-scale residential or commercial projects. The full-bodied formula delivers excellent coverage of 12m²/Ltr, hiding imperfections efficiently. Busy environments benefit from the durable, washable silk finish that is easy to wipe clean. A quick touch-dry time of 1 to 2 hours and a recoat time of 3 to 4 hours ensure rapid project turnaround using a brush, roller, or spray.
